g.text: [speaking (SpeechRecognition exists, or the browser can record)]
[recognition has not started in 2.5 s, or its service refuses]
without speech recognition or recording #mic stays hidden
The reply language follows the script of the
question; English letters get the #lang choice. T.hi and T.te hold
every template; clinic values stay as written.
Devanagari and Telugu digits are read as 0 to 9; a reply in another script is rejected
[no voice for that language, or it has not started in 3 s]
